components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'

        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:

## What I changed

The `GET /api/owners/{id}` response is an `OwnerDto` generated from `openapi.yml` and populated by the MapStruct `OwnerMapper`. I added the derived field there, mirroring the existing `locality`/`membershipLevel` pattern:

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added a read-only `contactPreference` string property to the `Owner` schema (so the DTO gains the field + setter on regeneration).

2. **`ContactPreferences.java`** (new, in the `mapper` package) — a tiny cohesive helper mirroring `Localities`: `preferenceOf(owner)` returns `"EMAIL"` when `owner.getEmail() != null`, else `"PHONE"`. 3. **`OwnerMapper.java`** — one added `@Mapping(... expression = "java(ContactPreferences.preferenceOf(owner))")` line.

The behaviour lives in a brand-new class with zero surrounding methods (`WMC_other = 0`), so it contributes almost nothing to the cost. The only pre-existing method touched is the `OwnerMapper.toOwnerDto` interface declaration — a single added annotation line, CC 1. I deliberately avoided growing any existing method or touching the large controller class, and used a plain `string` (not an OpenAPI `enum`) to avoid a generated enum type and the type-conversion complexity that would come with it.
